title: Generalize premium import function with progress tracking and UPSERT support
description: Replace the hardcoded ALLOWED_JENIS restriction and single-sheet assumption with a generalized importPremiumExcel() that supports all active blok premium types from premiumDefinitionService. Accept premium type parameter per sheet. Build correct metadata_json based on input_type. Add progress tracking following SeederProgress pattern. Leverage saveAdjustment's built-in UPSERT for idempotent imports.

files.change: Remove ALLOWED_JENIS constant. Replace hardcoded jenis validation with dynamic PremiumDefinitionService.validatePremiumName(). Replace hardcoded metadata_json (always blok) with input_type-aware metadata builder. Add SeederProgress tracking. Support multi-sheet import with per-sheet premium type designation.
Add premiumType parameter and dryRunConfirmationId parameter. Return type extended to include progress tracking fields (current_step, rows_processed, rows_total).

implementation: Remove ALLOWED_JENIS constant and normalizeJenis function
Add premiumType parameter to importPremiumExcel(): accepts premium definition name from active definitions
Validate premium type: call premiumDefinitionService.validatePremiumName(premiumType) for each sheet
Build metadata_json dynamically based on input_type: for blok -> MetadataBlok with items[] and total_amount
Add SeederProgress tracking: track total_rows, processed_rows, current_step, errors_count
Batch processing: group rows by empcode+premium_type, save each group via manualAdjustmentService.saveAdjustment()
Handle saveAdjustment UPSERT: existing records updated (amount, metadata_json, gang_code), new records inserted
Return extended PremiumImportResult with progress fields and per-row status
Add timeout protection: track elapsed time, stop if >180s, return partial results with remaining count

reference.pattern: historySeederService.ts SeederResult + SeederProgress pattern: success, imported/skipped counts, errors array, progress tracking with is_running/current_step
reference.examples: historySeederService.ts L29-L47 SeederResult: success, imported records count, errors array. premiumImportService.ts L96-L113 existing metadata_json build (hardcoded blok). manualAdjustmentService.ts L2190-L2237 existing record check + UPSERT logic.

criteria: importPremiumExcel() imports any active blok premium type from premium_definitions.json (not limited to PRUNING/RAKING)
metadata_json structure matches input_type (blok produces MetadataBlok with items[] and total_amount)
Re-importing same Excel file updates existing records (no duplicates created)
Progress tracking reports total/processed/error counts during import
Timeout at 180s returns partial results with clear remaining count

rationale.chosen_approach: Generalize the existing importPremiumExcel() function rather than creating a separate service. Leverage saveAdjustment's built-in UPSERT. Add progress tracking for visibility on large imports. Phase 1 limits to blok input_type but engine supports extension.
alternatives_considered: Create entirely new PremiumExcelSeederService separate from existing premiumImportService
DELETE-then-INSERT per premium type for simplicity
No progress tracking, just synchronous import
decision_factors: Code reuse: premiumImportService already has saveAdjustment integration
Data safety: UPSERT prevents data loss on re-import
Observability: progress tracking needed for files with hundreds of rows
Extensibility: engine design supports adding exp/kendaraan/amount input_types later
rationale.tradeoffs: Generalizing existing function risks breaking current PRUNING/RAKING imports. Must preserve backward compatibility or provide migration path. Multi-sheet support adds complexity but enables one-file multi-premium-type imports.

manual_checks: Import Excel with PREMI KINERJA (new type, was not in ALLOWED_JENIS) and verify success
Re-import same Excel file twice, verify no duplicate records in payroll_manual_adjustments
Import Excel with 500 rows, verify progress tracking updates during import
Import Excel with mixed valid/invalid rows, verify partial success with error reporting
success_metrics: Progress tracking updates at least every 50 rows processed
180s timeout enforcement with graceful partial results
